title: Mobile robot with camera unit and Lost & Found sign
visual_facts: A tall white mobile robot stands in front of a row of numbered lockers.
A rounded white device with a black multi-lens face is mounted on top of the robot and wrapped partly in clear plastic.
A large orange sign in front of the robot reads LOST & FOUND.
A printed notice on the robot includes the heading PERSONAL INFORMATION COLLECTION STATEMENT (PILOT).
The robot has turquoise curved graphics and text identifying Hong Kong International Airport near its lower front.
A small red circular object rests on the robot's upper surface.
spatial_relations: The camera-like unit is mounted atop the robot.
The orange sign overlaps the lower front of the robot in the foreground.
Numbered lockers line the wall behind the robot.
uncertainties: The small text on the printed notice is not fully readable.
The robot's specific operating capabilities are not shown.
